title: Prove the sharp five-translation minimum for a two-target switch (no κ)
body:
## Summary

For the two-target compact switch with radix 8, five-bit windows and constant source pair (1,1), the actual maximal invariant agreement core still requires exactly **five coordinate translations**. An explicit adversary defeats every four-entry menu, even with arbitrary constants in all control digits and windows.

Claim type: **finite certificate and scoped combinatorial proof**. The new exact core is

```text
u0 < 7, t0 < 7, t1 < 7, W0+t0 < 32
```

[PR6812](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6812), by Benny Zhao / zhaobenny, proves the five-entry minimum for a sufficient product guard and asks whether actual agreement permits fewer entries. This contribution settles that question negatively at the stated geometry with the endpoint-invariant selector contract. Its five-entry upper construction is credited prior work. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit John-Michael Smith, Hanson Sun, Arham Tahir, Aaron Wang, woklerx, Douglas Colkitt and the retained compact-switch lineage, plus Nick Petalas's older PR6231 translation interface. Full credit and exact provenance are in the package. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19539363).

## Evidence

Before: the sufficient-product minimum did not constrain the larger actual agreement core. After: direct enumeration classifies that core, and a written adversary proves four translations cannot cover it.

- All **16,777,216** complete dirty states checked. Raw agreement has **11,441,280** states; the invariant core has **10,185,728**.
- A separate digit-vector implementation checks both endpoint executions on all **131,072** quotient representatives.
- The five-entry menu covers every one of **16,384** relevant coordinate tuples. The adversary checks every one of **4,096** lower-temporary shift profiles with varied other constants. Its written proof covers arbitrary constants; this is not an enumeration of all menus.
- Four isolated clause-omission controls, an agreement-without-invariance witness, short-menu fixtures, six invalid menus and rejection of a five-entry adversary input pass.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass with identical generated, package-hash-bound receipts. Timed locally at **18.88 s** and **18.26 s**, within their 300 s limits. These are timeout-headroom measurements, not a speedup claim.
- Registered replay, metadata/pins, source compilation, staged whitespace and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. The preflight checks all six files and their reachable base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57.

Local environment: CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only. Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/compact-two-target-translation-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/compact-two-target-translation-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compact-two-target-translation-minimum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/compact-two-target-translation-minimum --check-source-history
```

Substitute a local CPython 3.12 executable elsewhere. Expected markers are `PASS_COMPACT_TWO_TARGET_TRANSLATION_MINIMUM`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. [Written proof and finite-domain contract](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7bc88f3fc12a6eb230df01a656afefdc70b205a7/research/compact-two-target-translation-minimum/PROOF.md).

## Limitations

The result fixes the raw word, source pair, widths, independent coordinate translations and a selector satisfying sigma(Tx)=sigma(x). It does not exclude changed words, coupled maps, other source functions or selector cleanup with extra retained state. Physical translations, selection, tape/precision, hosting, restoration invoices, native/compiler realization and analytic transfer remain unpriced or unproved. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. No all-parameter or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Does the minimum persist at other widths and radices? First derive a symbolic core formula for the same all-one two-target word. The finite classification does not establish that formula.
2. Can coupled translations or a non-invariant retained selector beat five at this geometry? First specify a concrete map and cleanup contract. Physical costs and legal implementation remain blockers.

## Related open work

Completion refresh read all ten open account PRs created since the CLAIM, including this PR. The nine others are #7189, #7191, #7192, #7193, #7194, #7195, #7196, #7198 and #7199. None studies this compact-switch translation minimum or computes the same invariant core. No extra numerical comparisons were run.

No same-object open PR surfaced in the earlier live open-PR, title/body and Discussion checks. PR6812 and the earlier PR6231/1603/1823/1856 are merged predecessors. The cached helper has sparse local-note coverage; direct origin/main README searches and live checks supplement it. Absence of a text match is not a novelty certificate.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `7bc88f3fc12a6eb230df01a656afefdc70b205a7`, [run 43001666262](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43001666262), [plan job 130459029974](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43001666262/job/130459029974), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the completed checks once and inspected the job log. It reports exactly one failure among 760 tests, with 24 skipped:

`test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`

The AssertionError says that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification document. On base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` names that command while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030. I confirmed the mismatch directly from those base Git objects and confirmed both files and the test are unchanged by this PR. The package [replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43001666262/job/130461478361) was skipped after plan failed.

I verified the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion and `failures=1, skipped=24` summary in all seven other failed run logs below:

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated research package. The selected record, shared code and frozen evidence are unchanged.
